title: Fix 262
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-history-006 already says a session that cannot be read is listed with the reason and the shelve recovery and stops no other command; only the readers and their tests change.
acceptance_criteria: With a FIFO named like a bug record in .chough/bugs/, chough status, chough next and chough bug list each exit 0 without blocking. With a FIFO in place of an open session's session.md, chough session list reports that session as not readable with a reason and the recovery chough session shelve <id>, another session's commands still work, and chough session shelve <id> moves the folder without blocking.

answers.constraints: The specs/cli/cli.3md lesson on native tasks applies: human gates are listed as plain text in tasks.md, not as checkboxes, and a delta is frozen at approval (this change has none). No other lesson or principle constrains it.
